info.title: BEQDesigner pipeline service
info.summary: Scan a library, extract and design BEQ filters for titles chosen by filter, on demand or on a schedule, and follow the jobs that do it.
info.description: A person decides a title through the review routes or in the BEQDesigner app. Every /v1 route needs the bearer token (Authorize, above). `GET /health` says which release this is.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The job it is an execution of.

job_name.title: Job Name
job_name.description: That job's name, while the job is kept.

number.title: Number
number.description: Which of its job's executions it is: 1, 2, ...

stopped_because.description: stopped: its window closed, or its job was paused or removed. Its job carries on with the titles it had not started.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it failed (a title that failed is in the result).

joined_to.title: Joined To
joined_to.description: The execution this one joined: its titles went into that run, and it ends when that run does, with its result.

window.title: Window
window.description: Its job's window (null: the default's; []: any time).

window_open.title: Window Open
window_open.description: Whether it may run now, with the default applied.

waiting_until.title: Waiting Until
waiting_until.description: A queued execution whose window is closed: when it next opens.

statistics.description: How it ran: on GET /v1/executions/{id} only.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once.

window.title: Window
window.description: Its window as given (null: the default's; []: any time).

next_at.title: Next At
next_at.description: When its next execution may start; null while paused, done, removed or running.

progress.description: A one-off: over every execution so far.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: A one-off run that stopped: titles its next execution does.

last_execution.title: Last Execution
last_execution.description: The id of its latest execution.

last_skip.title: Last Skip
last_skip.description: A recurring job: why its last due tick did not start one (busy, or the designer did not answer).

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: Why it is done, when it ended by itself (a recurring job whose ids are all done).

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Its titles by outcome, summed over the executions kept: on GET /v1/jobs/{id} only.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a person calls it; empty: what it does.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once. Only a run through extract or design recurs.

window.title: Window
window.description: The times of day it may run: daily "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges in the service's time zone (one may cross midnight, 22:00-06:00); outside them it waits, and a running execution stops between titles: its job carries on when they next open. null: the default window (/v1/job-window); []: any time.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Accept the designer's top pick at least this confident.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Say what would be accepted and change nothing.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: Accepted (or, in a dry run, that would be).

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Confident enough, but left for a person, and why.

kind.title: Kind

text.title: Text
text.description: What the person said, in their words (a note is only this).

AdjustmentAsk.description: A change asked of the designer (contract 1.5, design/designer-interface.md §2): a kind it lists, or any other.

url.title: Url

data_base64.title: Data Base64
data_base64.description: Or use this png or jpeg image, base64-encoded (at most 20 MB).

present.title: Present
present.description: The poster file is there to show (`GET /v1/titles/{id}/artwork`).

overridden.title: Overridden
overridden.description: A person chose it (or cleared it): a run never replaces it.

index.title: Index

text.title: Text

preferred.title: Preferred

Blocked.title: Blocked

index.title: Index

rejected.title: Rejected

window.title: Window
window.description: The window of every job given none: daily "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges; [] is any time.

parallel.title: Parallel

reachable.title: Reachable

designing.title: Designing

designer_build.title: Designer Build

release.title: Release
release.description: The release its /health named, when the design was sent; empty if it named none.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: Whether any of its endpoints' /health answered; null when there is nothing to ask (the manual designer) or the profile cannot be read.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The URLs that answered (and how many did not), else why none did.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Each endpoint the designer is served from (§7.2).

design_version.title: Design Version
design_version.description: What a redesign now would be made with: the highest design version among the endpoints that are up. A title designed with another (or with other settings) is out of date. Null when none reports one, and then no title can be judged out of date.

design_disagreement.title: Design Disagreement
design_disagreement.description: The endpoints that are up but would design differently, each in words; empty when they agree. A redesign then answers differently by endpoint.

adjustment_kinds.title: Adjustment Kinds
adjustment_kinds.description: The adjustments (contract 1.5) every endpoint up lists on its /health, by kind: {description, params: {name: {type, unit, minimum, maximum, default, description}}}. Empty when it takes none (a designer before 1.5).

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: The Review's digest: what was looked at.

source.title: Source
source.description: The design edited, by its index in the Review.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many of it in a row (a stacked shelf).

title_id.title: Title Id
title_id.description: The title the design is for.

title.title: Title
title.description: Its name, as the run knew it; empty when it had none.

next.title: Next
next.description: Each active job's next execution, soonest first.

executions.title: Executions
executions.description: Every execution kept, newest first (the running one included).

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Titles by outcome: designed, declined, extracted, already_done, failed, unavailable, skipped, not_reached (only those with any).

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: Why titles failed or were unavailable, grouped, most first.

skips.title: Skips
skips.description: Why titles were skipped, grouped, most first.

designers.title: Designers
designers.description: Each endpoint that designed for it, with the release and design version it named.

designers_differ.title: Designers Differ
designers_differ.description: Its designs came from more than one release or design version.

stages.title: Stages
stages.description: extract, waiting (for a design slot), designer (the design itself) and writing (its result): seconds a title.

ExecutionStatistics.title: ExecutionStatistics
ExecutionStatistics.description: How an execution ran (design/jobs-and-executions.md §2.3); a running one's grow as titles finish.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it failed, was unavailable, or was skipped.

waiting_seconds.title: Waiting Seconds
waiting_seconds.description: From waiting for a design slot to the designer being sent it.

writing_seconds.title: Writing Seconds
writing_seconds.description: From the designer's answer to the title's end in the run.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Its place in the job: events come in this order, and `after` resumes after one.

done_ms.title: Done Ms
done_ms.description: Audio extracted so far, in milliseconds.

total_ms.title: Total Ms
total_ms.description: The audio's length, in milliseconds; absent if ffmpeg did not say.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: done_ms of total_ms, 0 to 100; absent without total_ms.

ExtractProgressEvent.title: ExtractProgressEvent
ExtractProgressEvent.description: How far ffmpeg has got extracting a title (one every 5 seconds or so, and the last).

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: The titles to ask about; empty: every title whose design is out of date.

ImpactAsk.title: ImpactAsk
ImpactAsk.description: Ask the designer which designs a redesign now could move.

class.title: Class
class.description: The designer's name for the outcome class.

ImpactBasisView.title: ImpactBasisView
ImpactBasisView.description: What a change's scores were measured on, for one outcome class.

moved.title: Moved
moved.description: What the designer counts as moved, for display.

design_version.title: Design Version
design_version.description: The identity the answer is for: a check made at another identity than the designers report now is stale.

titles.title: Titles
titles.description: As a person reads them: will move and unknown first, then likely, possible, unaffected; highest score first within each.

ImpactCheck.title: ImpactCheck
ImpactCheck.description: The last check of what a redesign now would move, or the one running.

change.title: Change
change.description: The change it names (an id in the check's changes), or null.

feature.title: Feature
feature.description: The part of the design it reached, in the designer's words.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: unknown is read as will_move unless a person decides otherwise.

score.title: Score
score.description: The estimated probability that a redesign now moves it, so a sum is the expected number that move; orders titles within a tier, highest first; null for unknown.

unknown_reason.title: Unknown Reason
unknown_reason.description: Unknown only: why, as the designer's code (not_found, unknown_build, ...), or no_record when the design names no run record.

JobEvent.title: JobEvent
JobEvent.description: One thing a job reported, in order (`seq`). `type` says which fields it has, and every one has `text`.

done.title: Done
done.description: Title-stages done by its executions so far.

total.title: Total
total.description: How many its first execution set out to do.

window.title: Window
window.description: The times of day it may run: daily "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges in the service's time zone (one may cross midnight, 22:00-06:00); outside them it waits, and a running execution stops between titles: its job carries on when they next open. null: the default window (/v1/job-window); []: any time. Send null for the default.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once.

request.description: A recurring job's run, from its next execution.

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description: What changes: only the fields sent. A one-off's request is fixed; `every` and `request` are a recurring job's.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: The fields changed, as typed, by key; a blank one unsets it (blank episodes mean none).

extras.title: Extras
extras.description: What a TMDB reload filled that has no field of its own (overview, genres, collection), as the reload gave it.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `choices`: several of `choices`, as a comma-separated text; `choice`: one, typed or picked.

at.title: At
at.description: When it may start: null when it waits only for the one running.

job.description: The execution it is about; null for a scheduled run that was skipped (the designer did not answer), which `failed` names instead.

NotifyJob.title: NotifyJob
NotifyJob.description: The execution a notification is about, and its job.

label.title: Label
label.description: What the work list's action button would say.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

per_hour.title: Per Hour
per_hour.description: Title-stages finished per hour so far (a running job, once one is done).

remaining_seconds.title: Remaining Seconds
remaining_seconds.description: At that rate, how long the rest will take.

estimated_finish.title: Estimated Finish
estimated_finish.description: At that rate, when it will end.

name.title: Name
name.description: The file name, in the title's folder of the work directory.

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: It is written when the title is extracted.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: Its filter is no longer what the pipeline wrote: what is saved in it is what gets published, and a redesign keeps it.

flat.title: Flat
flat.description: It has no filter (not designed yet, or the designer declined).

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it could not be read; empty when it was.

index.title: Index
index.description: Its place in the catalogue's list for the title: what its chart is asked by.

same_track.title: Same Track
same_track.description: For the same audio, edition and episodes as this title, as far as is known.

catalogue_url.title: Catalogue Url
catalogue_url.description: Its page in the catalogue, when the catalogue says.

key.title: Key
key.description: The catalogue's key for the title; none when it has none.

compare_url.title: Compare Url
compare_url.description: The catalogue's page comparing every author's BEQ of it.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: Fingerprint of the designs offered: send it back in a Decision, which is refused if a redesign has changed them since.

chosen_index.title: Chosen Index
chosen_index.description: The design accepted or published, into the designs offered.

declined.description: The designer found nothing to correct; its one candidate is flat.

metadata_problems.title: Metadata Problems
metadata_problems.description: What publish would refuse: Accept is not offered until it is fixed.

in_flight.title: In Flight
in_flight.description: A run is working on this title now.

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: The playback chain the designer was told about.

metadata_digest.title: Metadata Digest
metadata_digest.description: What the metadata and artwork were read at: send it back with an edit, which is refused if they have changed since.

metadata_texts.title: Metadata Texts
metadata_texts.description: Each editable field as text, by key (`GET /v1/metadata/fields`).

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.description: What the next design is asked to change (contract 1.5): {id, kind, params, text, by, at, reason}.

variant_id.title: Variant Id
variant_id.description: Which design run this is (v1, v2...); none for one designed before they were numbered.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The title's other design runs, kept until discarded: use one again, or chart it beside this one.

adjusted_with.title: Adjusted With
adjusted_with.description: The adjustments the design here was made with (adjustments is what the next design is asked).

adjustment_outcomes.title: Adjustment Outcomes
adjustment_outcomes.description: The designer's answer to each: {id, outcome, applied, reason}; none for one it did not answer (a designer before 1.5).

Review.title: Review
Review.description: What a person decides a title on, and whether they can.

ReviewedAsk.title: ReviewedAsk
ReviewedAsk.description: Keep these titles' designs at the identity a redesign now would use, rather than redesign them.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was not kept, when it was not.

revised.title: Revised
revised.description: Sent back now (none when a job does it).

job.title: Job
job.description: The one-off redesign job doing it, when run was asked for.

window.title: Window
window.description: The times of day it may run: daily "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges in the service's time zone (one may cross midnight, 22:00-06:00); outside them it waits, and a running execution stops between titles: its job carries on when they next open. null: the default window (/v1/job-window); []: any time.

run.title: Run
run.description: With design or extract: do it now, in one run job (refused for review). Without: the titles wait for the next run.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.description: With design or extract: what the designer is asked to change, from now on, for every title sent (replacing what they had; [] asks for none). Absent: each keeps its own.

ReviseRequest.title: ReviseRequest
ReviseRequest.description: Send titles back: to review (decide again), design (designed again) or extract (extracted and designed again).

reverted.title: Reverted
reverted.description: Catalogue files whose unpublished changes were put back as git has them.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The job it is an execution of.

job_name.title: Job Name
job_name.description: That job's name, while the job is kept.

number.title: Number
number.description: Which of its job's executions it is: 1, 2, ...

stopped_because.description: stopped: its window closed, or its job was paused or removed. Its job carries on with the titles it had not started.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it failed (a title that failed is in the result).

joined_to.title: Joined To
joined_to.description: The execution this one joined: its titles went into that run, and it ends when that run does, with its result.

window.title: Window
window.description: Its job's window (null: the default's; []: any time).

window_open.title: Window Open
window_open.description: Whether it may run now, with the default applied.

waiting_until.title: Waiting Until
waiting_until.description: A queued execution whose window is closed: when it next opens.

statistics.description: How it ran: on GET /v1/executions/{id} only.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once.

window.title: Window
window.description: Its window as given (null: the default's; []: any time).

next_at.title: Next At
next_at.description: When its next execution may start; null while paused, done, removed or running.

progress.description: A one-off: over every execution so far.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: A one-off run that stopped: titles its next execution does.

last_execution.title: Last Execution
last_execution.description: The id of its latest execution.

last_skip.title: Last Skip
last_skip.description: A recurring job: why its last due tick did not start one (busy, or the designer did not answer).

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: Why it is done, when it ended by itself (a recurring job whose ids are all done).

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Its titles by outcome, summed over the executions kept: on GET /v1/jobs/{id} only.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a person calls it; empty: what it does.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once. Only a run through extract or design recurs.

through.description: Run every stage up to this one that each title still needs. A title waiting for review is never taken past design.

scan_first.title: Scan First
scan_first.description: List the sources before selecting, so new titles are seen.

retry_failed.title: Retry Failed
retry_failed.description: Also run titles whose extraction or design failed before.

redesign.title: Redesign
redesign.description: Invalidate the existing designs before running, then design them in one run (the whole designer pool at once). Requires through=design and either 1 to 500 ids and no other filter, or out_of_date=true (with any other filter but ids): every designed title it selects that is not accepted or published. The titles must be reviewed again.

revise_to.title: Revise To
revise_to.description: With redesign: send each title back to design (the default), or to extract it again.

audio_stream.title: Audio Stream
audio_stream.description: With redesign, revise_to=extract and one id: the audio stream (zero-based) to extract from now on.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Its place in the job: events come in this order, and `after` resumes after one.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: extract, design, publish or commit; absent once the run is over.

RunProgressEvent.title: RunProgressEvent
RunProgressEvent.description: The run started a title-stage: `done` of `total` are finished. The last has no title: the run is over.

scan.description: The scan taken first, if one was.

failed_earlier.title: Failed Earlier
failed_earlier.description: Not tried: failed before with the same source and settings.

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.description: Not done because something it depends on (the designer, the media storage, JRiver) was unavailable. Not remembered as failed: the next run tries it again.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.description: Why the run stopped before its selection was done, though nobody cancelled it: too many titles in a row met an unavailable dependency.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The job it is an execution of.

job_name.title: Job Name
job_name.description: That job's name, while the job is kept.

number.title: Number
number.description: Which of its job's executions it is: 1, 2, ...

error.title: Error
error.description: Why it failed (a title that failed is in the result).

window.description: Its job's window (null: the default's; []: any time).

window_open.description: Whether it may run now, with the default applied.

waiting_until.description: A queued execution whose window is closed: when it next opens.

statistics.description: How it ran: on GET /v1/executions/{id} only.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once.

window.title: Window
window.description: Its window as given (null: the default's; []: any time).

next_at.title: Next At
next_at.description: When its next execution may start; null while paused, done, removed or running.

progress.description: A one-off: over every execution so far.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: A one-off run that stopped: titles its next execution does.

last_execution.title: Last Execution
last_execution.description: The id of its latest execution.

last_skip.title: Last Skip
last_skip.description: A recurring job: why its last due tick did not start one (busy, or the designer did not answer).

ended.title: Ended
ended.description: Why it is done, when it ended by itself (a recurring job whose ids are all done).

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.description: Its titles by outcome, summed over the executions kept: on GET /v1/jobs/{id} only.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a person calls it; empty: what it does.

every.title: Every
every.description: Minutes from the end of one execution to the start of the next (at least 5); null: once. Only a run through extract or design recurs.

window.title: Window
window.description: The times of day it may run: daily "HH:MM-HH:MM" ranges in the service's time zone (one may cross midnight, 22:00-06:00); outside them it waits, and a running execution stops between titles: its job carries on when they next open. null: the default window (/v1/job-window); []: any time.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Sources to list again, by name; none is all of them.

allow_empty.title: Allow Empty
allow_empty.description: A source that now lists nothing replaces its titles (else it keeps them: an unmounted share).

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Source name -> why it could not be listed (its titles are kept).

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: Executions queued behind it, or waiting for their window.

tmdb.title: Tmdb
tmdb.description: Whether a TMDB key is set (TMDB_API_KEY): without one, titles are designed with the library's own metadata only.

repository_writes.title: Repository Writes
repository_writes.description: Whether publish, commit and bulk accept are allowed (allow_repository_writes in the service config).

repositories_configured.title: Repositories Configured
repositories_configured.description: Whether the profile names the filter repository that publish and commit write to.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many titles the figures are over.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Its place in the job: events come in this order, and `after` resumes after one.

state.title: State
state.description: queued, running, cancelling, stopping, succeeded, failed, cancelled, stopped or interrupted.

because.title: Because
because.description: stopping: its window closed, or its job was paused or removed.

StateEvent.title: StateEvent
StateEvent.description: The execution entered a state; the stream ends with a finished one.

design_version.title: Design Version
design_version.description: The design version it was designed with (contract 1.4, or from its build before it); null if unknown or not designed.

adjusted.title: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Its current design was asked to change something (contract 1.5).

unmet_adjustments.title: Unmet Adjustments
unmet_adjustments.description: How many of those the designer did not simply honour.

design_runs.title: Design Runs
design_runs.description: How many design runs it keeps (0: not designed).

design_choices.title: Design Choices
design_choices.description: The designs to choose from in every design run it keeps (candidates; the designer's rejected ones are not counted).

reviewed_at.title: Reviewed At
reviewed_at.description: The identities a person kept its design at rather than redesign it (contract 1.6): it is not out of date against them.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Its place in the job: events come in this order, and `after` resumes after one.

TitleEvent.title: TitleEvent
TitleEvent.description: Something that happened to a title: a stage started or finished, a command ran, it failed.

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: What the title needs next (any of these).

new_since_scan.title: New Since Scan
new_since_scan.description: Only titles first seen by the latest scan.

source.title: Source
source.description: Only titles from this source of the profile, by its name.

match.title: Match
match.description: Case-insensitive text in the title, name, id or path.

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Only these titles, by catalogue id.

anyOf.description: A year (2026), a comparison (<1960, <=1960, >1999, >=1999) or an inclusive range (1990-1999). A title with no year never matches.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Case-insensitive text in the title's detail (what it waits for).

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Only titles carrying every one of these flags.

declined.title: Declined
declined.description: true: only titles whose design the designer declined (waiting for review); false: only those it did not; unset: either.

out_of_date.title: Out Of Date
out_of_date.description: true: only designed titles a redesign now could answer differently -- designed with another design version, or other designer settings, than the designers that are up now design with (contract 1.4; a title designed before it takes its version from its build). false: every other title; unset: either. Refused (409) while no designer that is up says its design version.

adjusted.title: Adjusted
adjusted.description: true: only titles whose current design was asked to change something (contract 1.5); false: only those whose was not.

unmet.title: Unmet
unmet.description: true: only titles where the designer did not honour every adjustment asked (adapted, declined, not understood or unanswered).

several_runs.title: Several Runs
several_runs.description: true: only titles keeping earlier design runs (variants); false: only titles with one.

TitleFilter.title: TitleFilter
TitleFilter.description: Which titles: the work list's filters. Every field given must hold; none is every title.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: In a line, as the desktop title page's badge says it.

warn.title: Warn
warn.description: The summary is a warning (a project edited, or unreadable).

note.title: Note
note.description: What an edited project means for the title.

TitleSort.title: TitleSort
TitleSort.description: A column of the titles table to order by; without one, work-list order (tier, then oldest waiting first).

source.title: Source
source.description: Who chose it: `manual` (a person), `source` (the library), or empty (preferred).

probed.title: Probed
probed.description: The source listed none: read from the file now, and kept when one is chosen.

tmdb_id.title: Tmdb Id
tmdb_id.description: Look this TMDB id up; else search by title and year.

season.title: Season
season.description: A season makes it a TV search.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: The fields TMDB filled, as texts: apply them with a MetadataEdit.

extras.title: Extras
extras.description: overview, genres and collection, to send back as MetadataEdit.extras.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: The Review's digest: what was looked at.

designs.title: Designs
designs.description: How many designs it offered (candidates, then rejected).

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Its designs, as the Review's own: an index is into this run's offered designs.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: The designs the designer rejected in it.

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Its place in the job: events come in this order, and `after` resumes after one.

window.title: Window
window.description: The new window: absent for the default, [] for any time.
